text:
Changed llvm/lib/Debuginfod/Debuginfod.cpp and wrote the reason down in docs/decisions/llvm-handoff-debuginfod-timeout.md.

Commit message:
At the Harrowgate build farm a caching proxy in front of debuginfod streams only after fetching the whole artifact; the largest debug info takes 110-150 s on a cold cache, so a 90 s timeout left crash reports unsymbolized.

writes.docs/decisions/llvm-handoff-debuginfod-t:
# Why llvm/lib/Debuginfod/Debuginfod.cpp holds this value

At the Harrowgate build farm a caching proxy in front of debuginfod streams only after fetching the whole artifact; the largest debug info takes 110-150 s on a cold cache, so a 90 s timeout left crash reports unsymbolized.
